arguments.text: Start done. Settle now, long smooth strokes, race rhythm.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Hard start drained about half the pod reserve by 200 m. Plan: settle to about critical power (pod 165-175 W) through the middle, keep pod reserve above about 25 pct until 1500 m to go, then spend it evenly; final sprint from about 400 m. Compare legs in the same direction; leg 1 had current against (push about -0.1 m/s). Watch for incidents (rudder weed, instrument drift, radio).

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 20 pct: ease toward critical power
GPS speed well below what pod power should give: possible weed on rudder or drag, or strong current

text: Cued ease to settle after a hard start that drained half the pod reserve; set plan, reserve and drag watches, wake in 2 min to check.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more, breathe, this is a long race.

3.0 min: pod reserve 17 pct, pod power 186 W vs CP 168. Cued ease with 171 s/500 ground target (current against about -0.08 on leg 1). Goal: pod about 160-168 W until reserve recovers above 25 pct. Leg 1 ground speed about 3.0 m/s.
